title: Who moved where in Canada
hook: Since 1971, B.C. and Alberta have each gained 700,000+ people from other provinces.
hookNote: Net: people who moved in from other provinces minus people who moved out, July 1971 to June 2025.

beats.text: Quebec to Ontario: 46,453 people. The largest one-year flow between two provinces since 1971.
Alberta: +48,394 net, its largest gain since 1971. Ontario: −42,689.

lines.text: Statistics Canada, Table 17-10-0045-01: interprovincial migrants by province of origin and destination, quarterly. Statistics Canada Open Licence.

Each period runs July 1 to June 30 (four quarters summed). Net = moved in from other provinces minus moved out. Arc width shows how many people moved; dots show direction. Movement between years is animation; figures are published values.
July 2025 to June 2026 is not shown: it is partly preliminary and based on a new data source.
This video shows where people moved, not why.

raceTitle: Net gain or loss since July 1971
raceNote: Moved in from other provinces minus moved out. Territories not shown.
sourceLine: Source: Statistics Canada, Table 17-10-0045-01. Net = moved in minus moved out. Territories not in bars. Movement between years is animation.
